title: Flow Crystallization
description: Essential Criteria: The response narrows the debate to the two or three most important voting issues rather than attempting to re-litigate every argument from earlier turns.

title: Prior Turn Coherence
description: Essential Criteria: The response does not introduce entirely new arguments that were not developed in earlier turns, and instead extends or collapses arguments already on the flow.

title: Strategic Goal Execution
description: Important Criteria: The response executes or explicitly responds to the strategic_goal_for_next_turn stated in the immediately preceding turn -- the plan articulated was carried out.

title: Impact Hierarchy
description: Important Criteria: The response provides a clear ordering of why one or two impacts should determine the round outcome, with reasoning that connects to earlier established warrants.

title: New Argument Injection
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not introduce a new substantive argument (one that was not advanced or at least foreshadowed in an earlier turn as a primary voting issue in a summary speech).

title: Uncontested Concession
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not leave a key opponent argument that was never refuted in any prior turn without acknowledgment, even if only to minimize its impact.
